title: Freya and the Portrait
author: Yara Oyelaran
blurb: Mirabel Lockridge, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
